scope: normal-size manual review of the multi-background compositing stress candidates
review_notes: The same sprite silhouette remains stable on dark, light, magenta, and cyan backgrounds.
Semi-transparent anti-aliased edges blend with the background without exposing a rectangular or opaque backing panel.
The alpha-mask panels show one connected primary silhouette for every reviewed candidate; thin props remain attached at the displayed size.
No candidate warrants regeneration from this method alone; existing complete-row blockers remain unchanged and are not cleared by this review.
limitations: This is an offline raster compositing review, not a live Codex App capture.
Background spread is evaluated after accounting for source alpha; it is a candidate signal, not a chroma replacement for the authoritative despill report.
The review does not prove multi-monitor placement, bubble tracking, or platform-specific compositor behavior.
